# ghost/dictionary

Look up English words in freeDictionaryApp without accounts. Return the matching native word, parts of speech and complete visible definitions; clear only the current query, never open history, favourites, sharing or audio.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/dictionary
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/dictionary open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/dictionary search_word --device <serial> --param word=<word>
ghost skill run ghost/dictionary read_entry --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/dictionary clear_query --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open a clean dictionary query field without history or favourites
- `search_word`: Submit one public English word and read its visible definitions
- `read_entry`: Read the matching word, visible parts of speech and definitions
- `clear_query`: Clear only the current query field, without deleting saved history
